Presentation of the City's Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) for the Fiscal Year ended June 30, 2023, and Proposed Budget Amendments. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15060(c)(3) of the CEQA Guidelines since the actions are not a "project" as per Section 15378(b)(5). The actions involve organizational or administrative activities of government that will not result in direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Persons: Policy and Housing Planning Manager Anders and Housing Services Manager Dacey
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-13, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Approving an Agreement with Retread Inc. to provide Buena Creek Navigation Center (BCNC) operator services;" 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-14, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Authorizing the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the Master Lease Agreement for the Buena Creek Navigation Center (BCNC);" and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-07, titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Budget."

Environmental Considerations: The actions before the City Council are not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15060(c)(3) of the CEQA Guidelines since the actions are not a "project" pursuant to Section 15378(b)(5). The actions involve an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in a direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Environmental review will be conducted in connection with and prior to the adoption of any resulting ordinances. Contact Person: Senior Planner Jedynak
1) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a Second Amendment to the Professional Consultant Services Agreement, in substantial form, for Cannabis Management Services with HdL Companies; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-11 titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Amending the Fiscal Year 2023-24 Budget"; 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2024-12 titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Directing Staff to Initiate Amendments to the Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Program to Implement State Law SB 1186 Allowing Non-Storefront Medicinal Cannabis Delivery;" and 4) Receive a status update on retail cannabis applicants.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
